atAGlance: Gỏi đu đủ is green papaya salad, usually with herbs, peanuts, dried beef or shrimp, and tart fish sauce dressing.
whatItIs: Gỏi đu đủ is green papaya salad, usually shredded and tossed with herbs, peanuts, chili, and fish-sauce-lime dressing. It should be crunchy, sour, sweet, salty, and a little spicy.
howToEnjoy: Toss before eating so the dressing reaches the papaya, then taste before adding chili. Ask about dried beef or shrimp if you are avoiding either.
howLocalsOrder: Order gỏi đu đủ as a snack or shared salad. Ask for less spice, no peanuts, or no dried beef before it is tossed.
worthKnowing: In Vietnamese snack salads, green papaya is crisp and mild; the dressing and toppings provide most of the flavor.
goodToKnow: Ask for no chili if you want Gỏi đu đủ mild.
